idAndType: Immutable for an existing id; re-identification is retirement/deletion plus a new id at revision 1.
hardDelete: Only a Retired baseline object with no remaining incoming canonical references may be removed; Git preserves its history.
targetRevision: Capability targetRevision starts at 1. Normalized Target or Criteria change increments it exactly once; otherwise unchanged. It identifies criteria independently from the capability object revision, avoiding proof/status circularity.
